question: Who drafted and launched the Fifth Five Year Plan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**D.P. Dhar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **D.P. Dhar** was the key figure behind the drafting and launching of the Fifth Five Year Plan in India.
 
• The Fifth Five Year Plan aimed at achieving **self-reliance and poverty alleviation**.
 
• This plan covered the period from **1974 to 1979**.
 
• D.P. Dhar was a prominent Indian diplomat and politician who played a significant role in economic planning during this period.
 
• The plan was eventually terminated prematurely in 1978 by the subsequent government led by Prime Minister Morarji Desai.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five Year Plans in India**

 
 
• These were centralized and integrated national economic programs.
 
• The concept was derived from the Soviet Union's planning system.
 
• The first Five Year Plan was launched in 1951, focusing on the agricultural sector.
 
• India has had a total of twelve Five Year Plans before the planning commission was replaced by NITI Aayog in 2015.
 
 
 
• **D.P. Dhar**
 
 
• Dhar was an influential member of the Indian National Congress and closely associated with Indira Gandhi.
 
• He also served as the Indian Ambassador to the Soviet Union.
 
• His contributions were pivotal during the Indo-Pakistani War of 1971.
 
 
 
• **Objectives of the Fifth Five Year Plan**
 
 
• The plan targeted the reduction of poverty (Garibi Hatao) and attainment of self-reliance.
 
• It emphasized employment generation and equitable distribution of income.
 
• Special focus was on the development of the weaker sections of society.
 
 
 
• **Termination of the Fifth Five Year Plan**
 
 
• The plan was terminated in 1978 by the Janata Party government.
 
• The government introduced a new plan called the Rolling Plan.
 
• The Rolling Plan system was short-lived and was replaced by the Sixth Five Year Plan.
